sources.label: Center for Election Innovation & Research — Dates for 2026 Early In-Person and Mail Voting
vote.gov — confirm dates with your state

states.name: Alabama
states.note: No unexcused early voting. Voters with a qualifying excuse can vote absentee in person.

states.name: California
states.note: Every voter is mailed a ballot. In-person voting at the county elections office; other sites vary by county.

states.name: Colorado
states.note: Every voter is mailed a ballot; voter service centers open for in-person voting.

states.name: District of Columbia
states.note: Every voter is mailed a ballot. Confirm early vote center dates with DC BOE.

states.name: Florida
states.note: Required statewide from Oct. 24; counties may start as early as Oct. 19.

states.name: Hawaii
states.note: Every voter is mailed a ballot; voter service centers open for in-person voting.

states.name: Idaho
states.note: In-person absentee voting at the county clerk. Some counties run a shorter early-voting period that starts later.

states.name: Maine
states.note: In-person absentee voting at the town clerk's office; hours vary by town.

states.name: Michigan
states.note: Date shown is the statewide early-voting period. In-person absentee voting at the clerk's office starts earlier.

states.name: Mississippi
states.note: No unexcused early voting. Voters with a qualifying excuse can vote absentee in person.

states.name: Nevada
states.note: Every voter is mailed a ballot unless they opt out.

states.name: New Hampshire
states.note: No unexcused early voting. Voters with a qualifying excuse can vote absentee in person.

states.name: North Dakota
states.note: Earliest possible date. Early voting sites run only in some counties, each setting its own dates.

states.name: Oregon
states.note: Every voter is mailed a ballot; you can also vote at your county elections office once ballots are out.

states.name: Pennsylvania
states.note: On-demand mail voting at county offices; required by Oct. 20, and many counties start earlier.

states.name: Utah
states.note: Every voter is mailed a ballot. Counties may run a shorter in-person period.

states.name: Vermont
states.note: Every voter is mailed a ballot; in-person voting at the town clerk's office.

states.name: Washington
states.note: Every voter is mailed a ballot; voting centers open for in-person voting.
